profile.headline: Software Engineer looking for work
profile.summary:
Hi, I’m Eric. I am a software developer who is passionate about user connectivity, technology improving lives, innovation, exploring moonshots and enjoying life for what it is. I seek opportunities that let me make a difference in the user experience, making the world and everything in it more accessible and connected for everyone.

I have varied interests:

💻 As a software developer, I get involved with technologies that interest me, apply my knowledge of computer science to exploring fascinating research, observe the developer landscape both historically and futuristically, and look actively for exciting opportunities to meet interesting people and work on cool projects at progressive companies.

📚 As a mathematician, I study interesting subjects that help me better understand the world and give me new ideas both about it and for it. Personal favorites include graph theory(especially for computer science), abstract algebra(to try to see the symmetry and patterns in life, and to use these to better understand everything), and statistics(to make better informed decisions and try to approximate objective answers to some of the world's paramount questions).

🔆 As a dreamer, I explore every interesting idea that comes to mind! From philosophical considerations as to the good that business does to imagining my way into understanding parts of mathematics, this part of me relaxes me under pressure and motivates me when there is none.

Want to get in touch with me?? 
✉️ Email me at eric.filishtiner@gmail.com
Excited to get in touch with you!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States

positions.title: Development Team Lead
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
-Introduced weekly standups, daily documentation contributions, and code reviews, design reviews, team policies, and project boards open to new ideas that improved team productivity by over 100% on original design while appending newly contributing ideas along the way
-Led a team of software developers at various stages of development to become a cohesive unit
that built a single page recipe builder application a week ahead of schedule
-Collaborated with business team and its management to determine which features should be implemented both feasibly and productively by our developers while meeting business demands
-Introduced technologies for site and database hosting that minimized costs for project needs 
-Achieved maximum team happiness reviews through negotiating, balancing, and accommodating both wants and needs among engineers

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
-Integrated Google login API, neDB database into Glitch using Fastify for routing
-API to store API calls
-Designed full-stack API to integrate front end and back end
-Developed database schema and API for performing CRUD functionality on users
and associated attributes such as tags and recipes
-Innovatively implemented comments and connected comments to user profiles in our database, circumventing functionality of Disqus API
-Circumvented innate functionality of Disqus API to connect comments stored in Disqus to user 
profiles on our database

positions.title: Mathematics and Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
-Inspired students to learn advanced scientific concepts through the use of real-world scenarios and visualizations
-Improved grade outcomes to an average of B+ by establishing productive work habits among students
-Tutored both object-oriented programming and data structures in C++ and Java to computer science students
-Tutored linear algebra and calculus to computer science and mathematics students and fostered algorithmic thought in their scientific approaches
